intent: Annotate the domains of these proteins with every model in our domain library, which now includes the newly added porin_like model.
silent_error: hmmscan does not search the text .hmm file; it reads the binary files made earlier by hmmpress (.h3m/.h3i/.h3f/.h3p). porin_like was appended to domain_library.hmm after pressing, so the pressed files still hold only two models: the new model is never searched and the porin candidates come back with no domain hit. hmmscan neither compares timestamps nor warns, and the E-values are computed for a 2-model library. The tblout looks complete; hmmpress -f must be repeated.
